headline: CIN @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.11 at PIT 3.66, with a projected total of 7.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved -0.20 runs while PIT moved -0.73, changing the projected margin by +0.53 runs. The projected total fell -0.93, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chase Burns has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Brandon Lowe, Blake Dunn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags JJ Bleday, Billy Cook because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
